title: Download The Summit App
description: Archived Shanghai 2019 Summit mobile app information, including agenda planning, device download links and the original app support contact.
body:
Plan ahead & create your Summit agenda by downloading the official Open Infrastructure Summit app.

If you run into any issues, please contact summitapp@openstack.org for support.

Select your device to Download here.
